title: Te Tohunga: The ancient legends and traditions of the Maoris
summary: "Te Tohunga: The Ancient Legends and Traditions of the Maoris" by W. Dittmer is a collection of Maori myths and oral traditions written in the early 20th century. This work captures the cultural heritage of the Maori people, detailing their gods, ancestors, and mythological narratives that explain their understanding of the world around them.
